content.value_statement: Choosing a memorable domain can slow a launch and lead to weak brand choices. This skill generates focused name ideas, compares TLD options, and guides availability checks.
actual_capabilities: Generates creative domain candidates from a project description.
Suggests TLD options such as .com, .io, .dev, .ai, .app, and .co.
Explains why each name may fit the audience and brand.
Groups ideas by preferred extensions, alternative TLDs, and premium or taken names.
Provides naming tips for startups, personal brands, and products.
Recommends follow-up checks for social handles, trademarks, and brand identity.
limitations: Availability and pricing can change after the model responds.
It does not register domains or purchase names for you.
Trademark and legal checks still need qualified review.
Social handle availability may require separate external checks.

use_cases.title: Name a Startup Launch
use_cases.description: Create short domain options for a new company, then compare .com and alternative TLD choices.

use_cases.title: Plan a Personal Brand
use_cases.description: Generate professional domain ideas from a name, role, audience, and preferred tone.

use_cases.title: Explore Product Naming
use_cases.description: Brainstorm product domains that match features, market position, and expected customer language.

prompt_templates.title: Start With a Simple Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with project and audience context.
prompt_templates.prompt: I am launching [project]. It helps [audience] do [job]. Suggest domain names across .com, .io, and .app.

prompt_templates.title: Use Keywords and TLDs
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused naming with preferred words and extensions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Suggest domain names for [business]. Include the words [keywords] when useful. Prioritize [TLD list] and explain each choice.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Brand Directions
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for different naming styles.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create domain ideas for [product] in three styles: descriptive, brandable, and premium. Rank the strongest options.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Market Patterns
prompt_templates.prompt: Review naming patterns used by [competitors or category]. Then propose original domain ideas for [project] with availability-check notes.

output_examples.input: A tool for developers to share code snippets.
output_examples.output: Sample output: SnippetDock.dev for developer focus, CodeClip.app for action clarity, and PasteNest.io for a startup tone.

output_examples.input: A sustainable fashion brand with a clean tone.
output_examples.output: Sample output: LoomLeaf.co for a natural feel, ThreadEthic.com for trust, and WearRenew.fashion for category clarity.

output_examples.input: A personal portfolio for a data visualization consultant.
output_examples.output: Sample output: DataCanvas.dev for technical credibility, ChartStudio.co for service clarity, and VisualMetric.com for professional branding.

best_practices: Provide the project goal, audience, tone, and any required words.
Ask for a short list of preferred TLDs before comparing options.
Verify domain availability, social handles, and trademarks before launch.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for names without product or audience context.
Do not treat estimated availability as a final registrar result.
Do not choose names that are hard to spell or say aloud.

faq.question: Can this skill guarantee domain availability?
faq.answer: No. Availability changes quickly, so verify names with a registrar before making decisions.

faq.question: Does it register domains for me?
faq.answer: No. It helps choose candidates and next steps, but registration happens outside the skill.

faq.question: Can it focus on specific TLDs?
faq.answer: Yes. Tell it which extensions you prefer, such as .com, .ai, .dev, or .design.

faq.question: Can it help with personal brands?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide your name, profession, and preferred tone for tailored suggestions.

faq.question: Does it replace trademark research?
faq.answer: No. It can remind you to check conflicts, but it is not legal advice.

faq.question: Can I ask for competitor patterns?
faq.answer: Yes. Share the market or competitors, then ask for naming patterns and original alternatives.
